item.title: Induction Aluminum Foil Sealing Solutions for Bottled Products
item.description:
Advanced Induction Aluminum Foil Sealing for Bottled Goods
#

Induction aluminum foil sealing technology utilizes electromagnetic principles to generate instant, high heat. This heat melts a layer of aluminum foil, which then adheres securely to the opening of bottles. The result is a reliable seal that helps protect contents from moisture, leakage, and mildew, while also extending product shelf life.

item.title: Versatile Benchtop Solution for Bottle Capping Needs
item.description:
Versatile Benchtop Solution for Bottle Capping Needs
#

The LK-780 Semi-Auto Capping Machine is engineered to meet a wide range of capping requirements for metal, glass, and plastic bottles—excluding crowns and straight wall cork-style closures. This benchtop model is designed to deliver consistent and reliable performance, ensuring precise torque control for every application.
